name: A Valkyrie and a Songbird
source:
May and Ariel were once the center of each other's worlds. Then May left without a word, shattering Ariel. Now she's back, turning Ariel's world upside down once more.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
梅和爱丽儿曾经是彼此世界的中心。然后梅一言不发地离开了，这让艾瑞尔心碎了。现在她回来了，再次颠覆了爱丽儿的世界。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
